title: The Hobbit
description: A reluctant traveler joins a perilous quest across a richly imagined world, with courage growing through friendship and adventure.

title: The Time Machine
description: A scientist travels beyond his own era and confronts questions about progress, class, and the distant future.

title: And Then There Were None
description: Guests on an isolated island face a carefully constructed mystery as suspicion spreads through the group.

title: The Little Prince
description: A poetic encounter between a pilot and a young traveler explores friendship, imagination, and how people see one another.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut stranded far from home uses engineering, humor, and persistence to survive while a team works to bring him back.

title: Pride and Prejudice
description: A lively social novel follows sharp conversations, mistaken judgments, and a gradual change in how two people understand each other.

title: The Name of the Wind
description: A gifted musician recounts the early chapters of a life shaped by loss, learning, performance, and legend.

title: The Giver
description: A young person in a seemingly perfect community learns what has been removed from life and must decide what responsibility means.

title: The Wind in the Willows
description: Animal friends find warmth, mischief, and home in a gentle journey through riverside landscapes.

title: I, Robot
description: Linked stories examine the social and ethical consequences of increasingly capable robots and the rules meant to guide them.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
description: A detective and his companion investigate a frightening legend while evidence and reason compete with superstition.

title: The Alchemist
description: A young shepherd follows a recurring dream and a long journey that turns into a reflective search for meaning.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A hobbit named Frodo carries a perilous burden from a peaceful home into a vast world, joined by companions whose courage and loyalty shape the journey.

title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
description: Four siblings enter a snowbound world through a wardrobe and find a struggle against a force that has kept the land in winter.
